nodes.title: The case and investigation shapes follow the specification
nodes.summary: The aggregate changes the scope names — hash out of the case and the pin, position onto the hypothesis with precedence read from it, written_at on the investigation, authored_at on the case version — and the read paths that consume them.

nodes.title: The curator authors against the database
nodes.summary: The command contracts/knowledge/author-case-version publishes, with every validator rule answering at that write, and the curated vocabularies, registrations and case the database has to hold for a case to validate at all.

nodes.title: The four stores answer from the database
nodes.summary: The relational adapters behind ICaseStore, IGlossaryStore, ICapabilityStore and IInvestigationStore, and the one shared access helper they issue statements and open transactions through.

nodes.title: The relational substrate
nodes.summary: The connection the service reaches its database through, the configuration that names it, the numbered scripts that build the schema, and the arrangement that lets the suite run against a database the schema was applied to.

nodes.title: The service runs end to end on the database
nodes.summary: The wiring from environment to the four relational stores with no file left holding a record, and one diagnose call answered synchronously from the database with its investigation written before the response.

nodes.title: Backend service, its four file-backed stores and the case/investigation shapes around them
nodes.summary: The area the relational-persistence scope lands in: one layered TypeScript/Fastify service under src/, whose four store ports are implemented today by four plain-JSON file repositories and whose case and investigation shapes still carry the file-era fields.

nodes.title: The case aggregate carries the attributes the model declares
nodes.summary: The Case and Hypothesis types and the structural validator, with authored_at and position admitted, hash gone, and every structural refusal of one submission arriving together.

nodes.title: The published case read stops carrying a document hash
nodes.summary: ReadCaseResult and readCase drop the hash field contracts/knowledge/case-query and rules/investigation/replay-is-pinned no longer provide for; run-diagnosis.ts's own header comment stops describing the case pin as content-based.

nodes.title: An investigation carries written_at and pins its case by slug and version
nodes.summary: The investigation aggregate and the one place its pinned case is built, brought to the attributes the specification declares.

nodes.title: Precedence is read from the declared position
nodes.summary: Resolve-outcome and collection-plan, reading which hypothesis dominates which from each hypothesis's declared position rather than from the order it arrived in.

nodes.title: A replay resolves its case by slug and version
nodes.summary: The replay read that takes the pinned slug and version and answers with that stored version whole, without the validation the ordinary read runs.

nodes.title: The curator submits a case version whole
nodes.summary: The command that takes one case version, answers every validator rule at that write, and stores nothing when any of them refuses.

nodes.title: The curated vocabularies, registrations and case are in the database
nodes.summary: The seed that carries the fixture-era glossary, capability registry and one curated case version into the database, the case entering through the authoring command.

nodes.title: Seed reads its fixtures from a build that actually produced them
nodes.summary: The seed step, the source answering task/case-authoring/curated-data-seeded, stops assuming dist/ holds a copy of src/fixtures/ that no build step actually creates.

nodes.title: ICapabilityStore answers from the database
nodes.summary: The relational adapter behind the capability store port, holding each registration's declared contract and resolving one capability per concept.

nodes.title: ICaseStore answers from the database
nodes.summary: The relational adapter behind the case store port, reading a case whole in one transaction and refusing a version that was already written.

nodes.title: The one way an adapter runs a statement
nodes.summary: The shared access helper that answers absence as data, raises the caller's typed error, and gives an adapter a transaction that commits or rolls back whole.

nodes.title: IGlossaryStore answers from the database
nodes.summary: The relational adapter behind the glossary store port, answering the five vocabularies and the concepts exactly as the database holds them.

nodes.title: IInvestigationStore answers from the database
nodes.summary: The relational adapter behind the investigation store port, writing one record whole in one transaction, refusing a second write of an id already stored, and reading back every part the record declared.

nodes.title: The service reaches its database through a configured connection
nodes.summary: The driver, the connection module beside the persistence adapters, and the connection URL added to the single environment schema.

nodes.title: Integration tests are isolated from each other against one database
nodes.summary: The arrangement that lets tests sharing one database each observe only the rows they arranged.

nodes.title: The manifest's env-loading scripts and their own tests agree
nodes.summary: package.json's migrate and seed scripts load .env themselves via node --env-file, a wanted capability the human decided to keep; the two unit tests asserting their old literal text are updated to match, without weakening either assertion.

nodes.title: The schema is applied by a step the tree records
nodes.summary: A runnable step that applies every migration in order against the configured connection, and the suite setup that runs it so no test creates a table.

nodes.title: The schema is built by numbered scripts that mirror the declared model
nodes.summary: The SQL scripts under migrations/ that create every relation the system records into, each column pairing with an attribute a Domain Model element declares and each key holding an invariant the specification states.

nodes.title: A diagnosis runs against the database
nodes.summary: One diagnose call answered synchronously from the case, glossary and registrations the database holds, with the investigation written before the response and an error rather than an assessment when the write does not conclude.

nodes.title: Every store is wired from the connection and no file holds a record
nodes.summary: The factories and the environment rebuilt around one connection for the four persistence stores, with their file repositories and file helper gone from the tree.
